title: Inventions that could change lives
objective: Comprendre la présentation d'inventions et évaluer leur utilité en faisant des hypothèses

steps.title: Warm-up: useful or useless?
steps.student_instruction: Look at four strange inventions. Vote: useful or useless? Say why in one sentence.
steps.facilitator_instruction: Images inventées (parapluie à ventilateur, fourchette connectée…). Faire produire It could help... / It would be...

steps.title: Listening: new inventions
steps.student_instruction: Listen to the radio show. Fill in the grid: invention / what it does / opinion of the correspondent.
steps.facilitator_instruction: Audio British Council « New inventions » (QR code du cahier) ; sans réseau, lire deux fois le script de secours. Deux écoutes ; la seconde ciblée sur les opinions.

steps.title: Language focus: could, might, would and the second conditional
steps.student_instruction: Complete: If I ___ (have) a wingsuit, I ___ (fly) over the mountains. This distiller could ___ thousands of people.
steps.facilitator_instruction: Modaux de possibilité (could / might) et second conditionnel (If + prétérit, would + base verbale) pour une hypothèse.

steps.title: Differentiated practice
steps.student_instruction: Complete your A, B or C sheet, then compare with a partner.
steps.facilitator_instruction: A : appariement invention / fonction et phrases au conditionnel guidées ; B : fiche de présentation d'une invention ; C : texte sur la responsabilité des inventeurs.

steps.title: Group task: pitch your invention
steps.student_instruction: In groups, invent something that could solve a real problem. Pitch it in one minute: what it does, who it helps, one risk.
steps.facilitator_instruction: Façon « concours d'innovation » : la classe vote pour l'invention la plus utile. Exiger un second conditionnel et un modal de possibilité.

steps.title: Exit ticket
steps.student_instruction: Write one second conditional sentence about an invention.
steps.facilitator_instruction: Ramasser ; repérer If I would have (erreur fréquente).

sheets.student_content: Match the inventions (wingsuit, solar distiller, talking gloves, bottle coating) with what they do. Then complete: If I ___ (can) invent something, I ___ (make)...
sheets.facilitator_correction: wingsuit - glide in the air ; solar distiller - turns salty water into drinking water ; gloves - translate sign language into speech ; coating - helps ketchup come out of bottles. could - would make.

sheets.student_content: Choose one invention from the recording. Write a 100-word fact file: inventor, what it does, who it could help, one limit.
sheets.facilitator_correction: Exemple : solar distiller, Gabriele Diamanti, sunlight turns salty water into drinking water, could help people without clean water, needs investors.

sheets.student_content: Write a 180-word text: "Inventors are responsible for how their inventions are used." Do you agree?
sheets.facilitator_correction: Production libre ; attendus : exemples précis, second conditionnel, modaux, nuance (to some extent, nevertheless).

criteria: L'élève relève la fonction d'au moins trois inventions
L'élève formule une hypothèse au second conditionnel
L'élève évalue l'utilité et une limite d'une invention

common_errors: If I would have... (would dans la subordonnée)
could + to : it could to help
